water_public_tang_kui.title: Water tower memory / Half a bucket

lines.speaker: tang_kui
lines.text: About the water tower. I was too sharp with you.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Start with counting me as half a bucket.

lines.speaker: tang_kui
lines.text: That one stays. You are more useful than a bucket.

lines.speaker: tang_kui
lines.text: And... I was glad you stopped to listen to me yell.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: The water was so loud, I actually--

lines.speaker: su_mi
lines.text: When you opened the courtyard tap, Tang Kui rattled my headset.

lines.speaker: su_mi
lines.text: She said she was not crying.

water_public_shen_yanshuang.title: Water tower memory / At the gate

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: How long were you standing at the gate?

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Tang Kui says you never moved after we left.

lines.speaker: shen_yanshuang
lines.text: Still has the strength to tell on me. She got her water, then.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: About opening the courtyard tap first--

lines.speaker: shen_yanshuang
lines.text: Next time, do not make me guess over the radio whether you can still stand.

lines.speaker: tang_kui
lines.text: Do not look at me. I am still angry.

lines.speaker: tang_kui
lines.text: Does that mean I cannot dry you off?

water_tanker_shen_yanshuang.title: Water tower memory / The biggest bucket

lines.speaker: shen_yanshuang
lines.text: Tang Kui saved me a bucket.

lines.speaker: shen_yanshuang
lines.text: Yes. My name is bigger than the number plate.

lines.speaker: shen_yanshuang
lines.text: Next time she yells at me, do not join in.

lines.speaker: su_mi
lines.text: Shen Yanshuang asked if the writing on the bucket would wash off.

lines.speaker: su_mi
lines.text: She never asked me to wash it.
